rationale: C14 plausibly supplied a material structural template for the later letter: a privately supported historical repository centered on a prominent public figure's papers; cooperation with the National Archives and General Services Administration; provision of documentary material and public access; and temporary withholding of classified records followed by release when permissible. The child greatly expands this into a formal conditional gift instrument with transfer, custody, access, sealing, review, and intellectual-property terms, but C14 contains a concrete core of the same archival-depository arrangement. C10 is thematically close on preserving and publishing historically important papers but lacks the repository-transfer machinery. C22 supplies relevant classification and continuing-review mechanisms, but those are general security regulations rather than a template for the overall donation letter.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Eisenhower Presidential Library Commission... has under construction... a library building... where it is proposed to house my Presidential and other papers.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The purpose of the Foundation will be to collect and receive papers and records relating to the life and public service of General Marshall... and to provide a suitable building to house them at V.M.I.
shared_material.explanation: Both describe a privately financed or supported institution and dedicated building created to collect and house the papers of a major public figure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I now offer as a gift to the United States such of my papers and other documentary materials as are hereinafter described
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the United States Government would in so far as practicable make available to the Foundation documentary material relating to the activities of General Marshall
shared_material.explanation: Both use an arrangement for transferring or supplying a defined body of historically significant documentary material to the repository.

shared_material.child_excerpt: All papers placed under seal... shall be reexamined from time to time... and... shall be opened to research use as soon as... circumstances have removed the conditions that required that they be put under seal.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Many of the pertinent Government records will remain classified or will be withheld from the public for a number of years. As rapidly as they can be made public, however, I hope they will be made available to the Foundation.
shared_material.explanation: Both establish the same archival-access progression: classified or otherwise sensitive records are withheld initially and made available as soon as restrictions permit.
